notes.title: Ghost Frequency launches May 26th 🎥📱👻
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3173740/Ghost_Frequency/?curator_clanid=43702061][b]Ghost Frequency[/b][/url] officially launches on May 26th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245619/d31edaedeaf362725ff3730059e5ff62ba521707.jpg[/img]

Play as Mark, an experienced ghost hunter. Armed with only your gear, instincts, and guidance from your partner Emily, you'll investigate the mysterious disappearance of your teammates, Lisa and Ben, who vanished during a previous expedition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245619/e30722aa3821af0b9ad94ba578c676cf9d52ef62.jpg[/img]

Inspired by the real-world fieldwork of Italy’s PIT – Paranormal Investigation Team, Ghost Frequency faithfully incorporates their actual tools and methods. The Ghost Finder app, based directly on their own technology, becomes your main ally as you explore the haunted house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245619/a2d5b6d915e0b20c5ad013382fbb57c7a95ca9e8.jpg[/img]

🔹 EMF Detector – Reveal electromagnetic anomalies and trace energy signatures.
🔹 EVP Recorder – Capture ghostly whispers and sounds hidden in ultrasonic frequencies.
🔹 IR Thermal Camera – Detect unseen entities through heat signatures and anomalies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245619/c82d37f169b9b61cf1c01a21322188f401639749.jpg[/img]

But this isn’t just about tech. You'll need to carefully place surveillance cameras, recover lost tapes, dig through documents, and uncover traces left behind by those who came before. 

[previewyoutube=-wqefTgkPCg;full][/previewyoutube]

🎮 Add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3173740/Ghost_Frequency/?curator_clanid=43702061][b]Ghost Frequency[/b][/url] to your Wishlist now and prepare to begin the hunt on May 26th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3173740/Ghost_Frequency/?curator_clanid=43702061

notes.title: BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH - RELEASE DATE ANNOUCEMENT
notes.content:
We're super excited to share that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/][b][i]BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH[/i][/b][/url], the next chapter in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][i][b]BrokenLore[/b][/i][/url] series, is coming to Steam on [b]March 20th, 2025[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/68e0454c875a4fbef737b42e49a3e544f601912d.png[/img]

This time, we're diving into the tough subject of social anxiety, with Shinji as our main character. He’s a young hikikomori, living in isolation in his Tokyo apartment, struggling with the outside world.

[previewyoutube=BdNmf29ECOw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven’t already, be sure to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014520/BrokenLore_LOW/][i][b]BrokenLore: LOW[/b][/i][/url], the first chapter of the series, which we released recently.

Dear players,

We would like to inform you that, due to some exciting news we will be announcing very soon, the release date of our video game has been postponed to April 25, 2025. We are excited to share these new developments with you, which we believe will bring great benefits to the entire series.

Thank you for your continued support and patience.
More details will be shared soon!

notes.title: Celebrating NextFest with PIT
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to see the positive responses from players regarding [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3173740/Ghost_Frequency/][i]Ghost Frequency[/i][/url]! It’s heartwarming to witness many of you diving back in to explore as much as possible before the camera battery runs out. Your enthusiasm truly motivates us!

As you progress through the game, you'll discover many new mechanics that enhance the experience, and we hope you enjoy the unfolding story as much as we enjoyed creating it.

The Steam Festival has been wonderful for us, not only with Ghost Frequency but also with our other titles:

[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/]BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH[/url][/i]
Step into the shoes of a hikikomori who lives in isolation in his Tokyo apartment.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014520/BrokenLore_LOW/][i]BrokenLore: LOW[/i][/url]
An atmospheric horror set in a beautiful rural Japanese town shrouded in mist, hiding a dark curse.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014520/BrokenLore_LOW/

We’re also excited to share that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376200/KARMA_The_Dark_World/][i]KARMA: The Dark World[/i][/url] mentioned us in one of their posts on their Steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376200/KARMA_The_Dark_World/

For those who haven’t heard of it yet, KARMA is a first-person cinematic psychological thriller set in a dystopian world where the Leviathan Corporation is omnipresent. The year is 1984, the place is East Germany, and things are not quite what they seem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245619/f8c009b5c0e959418aa1054b8dddf5fe5abf13db.jpg[/img]

Investigate the twisted environments of suspects' memories and the horrors that lurk within the corners of their minds. If that sounds intriguing, be sure to add it to your wishlist and check out the demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245619/b2777449790d1ce63927a6e765f73e3aece522ce.jpg[/img]

Looking for more exciting games? Don’t forget to follow us on Steam!

JOIN US: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245619/9600352861a3a0a655b739f2235debf1779ae4dc.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Ghost Frequency Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that the Ghost Frequency demo is now live! It’s been amazing to see your positive feedback already, and we’re thrilled that so many of you are diving into the experience. 

This is just a taste of what's to come in the full game, and we’re glad to hear the atmosphere and mechanics are already resonating with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245619/74fd923892a208b19e9557f41356305efbc45a54.gif[/img]

We know the demo is short, but the goal was to provide a quick teaser that captures the feel of the game. Your excitement and interest mean the world to us, and it's great to see how many of you are curious about what's next. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245619/b11c954ec9fa3ba41dcb299a898858150c2e2ec6.gif[/img]

We’re even considering extending the demo slightly, so stay tuned for any updates on that!
We can’t wait to share more with you soon!
